engine: ES VWAP-RVOL RECLAIM RESEARCH V1 LOCKED
data: QuantConnect continuous ES minute data consolidated to 5-minute bars

rules.rvol: current five-minute volume / prior 20 sessions at the same time >= 2.0
rules.reclaim: prior close below prior VWAP; current low below VWAP; current close at least two ticks above VWAP
rules.risk: one tick below reclaim low and 0.45-1.0 five-minute ATR(14)
rules.target: session volume-weighted +1 standard-deviation band fixed at entry
rules.costs: $5 round turn + 1 ES tick entry + 1 ES tick exit
rules.news_lockout: not applied because no point-in-time Tier-1 release calendar was supplied

limitations: The proposal requested a dynamically re-evaluated target, but doing so would allow the target to move away from price. This test fixes the actual +1 standard-deviation band at entry to keep risk and reward defined.
The proposal's sample code used daily ATR despite describing five-minute ATR. This test uses five-minute ATR(14), consistent with the written rule.
QuantConnect free Object Store writes were denied, so aggregate metrics were retained through debug output instead of a downloadable trade log.
conclusion: REJECT V1: the locked VWAP-RVOL reclaim was negative in both development and untouched validation periods. Do not optimize thresholds from this small losing sample and do not integrate it into the live dashboard.
